Company snapshot:

- Launch cadence: weekly promos + monthly flash sales -> highly bursty traffic windows.

Primary goals and constraints:
- Primary: embed a lightweight Product Q&A widget on product pages to reduce CS load and increase conversions.
- Secondary: automated catalog enrichment (meta titles, short descriptions, normalized attributes) to improve discovery.
- Latency SLO: ~150-250ms p95 for widget responses on page load; willing to accept slightly higher for complex RAG flows.
- Throughput: baseline 5-10 rps, peak bursts up to ~60 rps during promos.
- Cost sensitivity: high — wants to keep per-session cost < $0.10 typical.
- Model preference: open / cost-efficient models or Redwood-recommended smaller variants for most queries; fallback to a stronger model for long-tail/spec-heavy requests.
- Data handling: public cloud acceptable, but needs SOC2 & audit logs for investor due diligence. No on-prem requirement at this stage.
